{{Quote|Admiral Coburn, we have the survivors. Recall all fighters.''"<br />"''Yes, General. ''[To his bridge crew]'' Prepare to jump to lightspeed.|Plo Koon and Coburn|audio=RecallAllFighters-CR.flac|<ref name="Citadel Rescue" />}}
[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] '''Coburn''' was a respected [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] [[Republic officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] who served with [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A hardline and highly disciplined [[Commander/Legends|commander]], he had an unmistakable command presence due to his taciturnity and ran a tight [[Starship/Legends|ship]] aboard his [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]]. He worked closely with Koon and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|Wolffe]] of the [[104th Battalion/Legends|104th Battalion]] in coordinating some of the most dangerous operations, as part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] war effort against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

In the war's [[21 BBY/Legends|second year]], Coburn led a four-[[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] fleet to the Separatist stronghold of [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]] to [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|retrieve]] a group of Republic [[Prisoner/Legends|hostages]] and their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] rescuers from the notorious [[Prison/Legends|prison]] known as the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]]. While Coburn commanded the Republic fleet [[Space warfare/Legends|against]] the [[Lola Sayu defense fleet/Legends|enemy blockade]] of Lola Sayu, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Masters]] Koon, [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]], and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] rescued the survivors from the surface. Coburn and his task force were able to pull out with minimal [[Death/Legends|casualties]].

At [[Kadavo/Legends|Kadavo]], Coburn took part in another successful operation, overseeing the [[Arquitens-class light cruiser/Legends|light cruiser]] [[Hand of Justice/Legends|''Hand of Justice'']], which was instrumental in the [[Battle of Kadavo/Legends|rescue]] of a number of [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] colonists who had been [[Battle of Kiros|captured]] and [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by the Separatist-backed [[Zygerrian Slave Empire/Legends|Zygerrian Slave Empire]]. As part of the operation, Coburn brought the ''Hand of Justice'' dangerously close to the [[Kadavo slave processing facility/Legends|slave processing facility]] to save the Togrutas from their holding cell.

==Biography==
===Rescue from Lola Sayu===
{{Quote|We're all ready, Admiral.|Plo Koon orders Coburn to initiate the jump to hyperspace|audio=ReadyAdmiral-CR.flac|<ref name="Citadel Rescue" />}}
Coburn lived during the final [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] rule, during which [[Time/Legends|time]] [[Gender/Legends|he]] began a career in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]]. By the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Coburn had become a respected [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] [[Republic officer/Legends|officer]] and earned the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] within the [[Navy/Legends|Navy]] of the Republic. He was given command of his own [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]], from which he oversaw Republic fleets on a number of battlefields. As part of his wartime service against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Coburn was assigned to serve with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], an accomplished [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] with whom he spearheaded various campaigns in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] war theater. Coburn also formed a close working relationship with [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|CC-3636]], nicknamed "Wolffe," who led Koon's [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Battalion/Legends|unit]], the [[104th Battalion/Legends|104th Battalion]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the war,<ref name="FF-2014 24: Malevolence">{{FactFile2014|24|22 BBY 87-88|The ''Malevolence'' Campaign}}</ref> Koon's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Triumphant/Legends|''Triumphant'']], was [[Battle of Abregado/Legends|destroyed]] by the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|battleship]], the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']]. Although Koon, Wolffe, and their 104th [[Wolfpack/Legends|Wolfpack]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] survived the attack,<ref name="Rising Malevolence">{{TCW|Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence''}}</ref> Coburn could not forget the loss of the ''Triumphant''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

[[File:Coburn-CR.png|thumb|left|250px|Coburn commands the Republic rescue fleet from his Star Destroyer at Lola Sayu.]]
As the war continued, Koon and Coburn were assigned to take a task force<ref name="Citadel Rescue" /> in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]<ref name="FF-2014 45: Citadel">Although the section title of {{FactFile2014|45|20 BBY 15-18|The Citadel}} lists a date of [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] for "[[Citadel Rescue]]," the section itself states in-text that the episode's events occur "during the second [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]," which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes as [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. This article assumes the latter is correct.</ref> to [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]], a [[Planet/Legends|world]] deep in enemy [[Realspace/Legends|space]] that was home to the Separatist [[Prison/Legends|prison]] known as the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]]. There, an elite team of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] had been sent by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] to [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|rescue]] Jedi Master [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]], who had been [[Capture of Even Piell/Legends|captured]] and [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] alongside the crew of his [[Even Piell's cruiser/Legends|Star Destroyer]] for his possession of the coordinates to the strategic [[Nexus Route/Legends|Nexus Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. The Republic strike team had succeeded in rescuing Piell and the other hostages from the Citadel, but their [[Shuttle 81572/Legends|shuttle]] had been destroyed during the course of the operation, necessitating a retrieval from the planet's surface. Koon and fellow Jedi Masters [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]], and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] were dispatched to Lola Sayu with Coburn and a four-[[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] fleet of ''Venator''-class Star Destroyers to perform the extraction. Coburn was to assume command of the fleet to [[Space warfare/Legends|challenge]] the [[Lola Sayu defense fleet/Legends|Separatist blockade]] over the planet, while Gallia, Tiin, and Fisto were to serve as [[Wing Commander/Legends|wing commanders]] for the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]]. Once the enemy [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] had been breached, Koon and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Wolffe would move in with a [[Space gunship/Legends|space gunship]] to extract Piell and the rescue team from the surface of the planet.<ref name="Citadel Rescue" />

Upon emerging from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in the [[Lola Sayu system/Legends|Lola Sayu system]], the Republic fleet began its assault on the Separatist blockade, which consisted of a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ship]], a [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyer]], and four [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]]. While Tiin, Gallia, and Fisto each took a squadron of [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighters]] to [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]] the enemy [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla's]] [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]], Coburn had his [[Warship/Legends|warships]] exchange heavy [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] [[Laser/Legends|fire]] with those of the blockade. Eventually, Koon and his [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] were able to break through the blockade with the assistance of the Jedi [[Fighter wing/Legends|wing]] commanders, and Koon immediately instructed Coburn to recall all starfighter squadrons in preparation to jump to hyperspace. Coburn complied, and the Republic fleet was ready to escape by the time that Koon and his comrades returned to Coburn's Star Destroyer with the strike team aboard. The task force proceeded back to the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] began discussing the best way to debrief the intelligence on the Nexus Route. Piell, who had divided half of the information with Republic Navy [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] for security purposes, had [[Death/Legends|died]] on Lola Sayu during the strike team's escape, but he entrusted his half of the information to Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] before passing on.<ref name="Citadel Rescue" />

===Battle at Kadavo===
{{Dialogue|Tano|We need to have the cruiser move in underneath the facility. We can escape onto the ship if Admiral Coburn can get in close enough.|Coburn|You heard Commander Tano. I want the men topside with rocket packs and cable guns. ''Move it!''<nowiki></nowiki>|Wolffe|Yes, sir!|attr=Coburn orders Wolffe to execute Ahsoka Tano's plan to rescue the Togruta colonists|audio=MoveIt-EFK.flac|src=<ref name="Escape from Kadavo">{{TCW|Escape from Kadavo}}</ref>}}
[[File:CoburnWolfpack-EFK.png|thumb|right|250px|Coburn and Wolffe move in with the ''Hand of Justice'' to rescue the Togruta colonists.]]
As part of a later operation to rescue [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] colonists who had been [[Battle of Kiros|captured]] and [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by the Confederacy and the [[Zygerrian Slave Empire/Legends|Zygerrian Slave Empire]], Coburn and his Star Destroyer joined a campaign led by Koon, Jedi General [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and the latter's Padawan, Ahsoka Tano, to [[Battle of Kadavo/Legends|liberate]] the Togruta slaves from a [[Kadavo slave processing facility/Legends|slave processing facility]] on the planet [[Kadavo/Legends|Kadavo]]. Upon exiting hyperspace in the [[Kadavo system/Legends|Kadavo system]], Koon launched from Coburn's Star Destroyer with a squadron of [[Clone Z-95 starfighter/Legends|clone Z-95 starfighters]] and [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]], while Coburn boarded his [[Arquitens-class light cruiser/Legends|''Arquitens''-class light cruiser]],<ref name="Escape from Kadavo" /> the [[Hand of Justice/Legends|''Hand of Justice'']],<ref name="TCWEG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref> with Commander Wolffe and brought it to the surface, leaving his flagship in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of Kadavo. Remaining in the planet's upper [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] with the ''Hand of Justice'', Coburn waited for Koon and his Wolfpack [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|pilots]] to take out the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrians]]' defenses, consisting of turbolaser [[Autoturret/Legends|turrets]] and [[HH-87 Starhopper/Legends|HH-87 Starhoppers]]. Eventually, Skywalker signaled to Koon and Coburn that it was safe to land the ''Hand of Justice'' at the facility's landing pad to evacuate the slaves, in accordance with their original plan. However, Tano reported that they had to reconsider their strategy, as the Togrutas had been trapped in a holding cell and would be unable to reach the landing platform.<ref name="Escape from Kadavo" />

[[File:CoburnAtTheHelm-EFK.png|thumb|left|250px|Admiral Coburn as he brings his ''Arquitens''-class light cruiser in to rescue the Togruta slaves.]]
Thinking quickly, Tano developed a plan to have Coburn move in with the ''Hand of Justice'' underneath the suspended facility, as the holding cell was opening onto the [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] crater below. The Togrutas would then be able to escape onto the [[Light cruiser/Legends|light cruiser's]] [[Hull/Legends|hull]]. Committing to Tano's stratagem, Coburn ordered Wolffe and four other troopers, including [[Sinker/Legends|Sinker]] and [[Comet (clone trooper)/Legends|Comet]], onto the hull so that they could provide support for the Togrutas with [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]] and their [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifles]]' [[Ascension gun/Legends|ascension guns]]. Coburn had his clone trooper crew move the ''Hand of Justice'' underneath the facility as best they could<ref name="Escape from Kadavo" /> in spite of the dangerous proximity to the station.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Once they were in place, Wolffe took his men topside and had them fire their [[Grappling hook/Legends|ascension cables]] onto the ceiling of the holding facility, so that the Togrutas would have cables to descend safely onto the hull. Tano and the clones helped the Togruta colonists reach the cruiser, and they were able to rescue all of them from the holding cell. Once Coburn moved the ''Hand of Justice'' away from the facility, Koon had his gunships fire upon the slave processing station, compromising its supports and plunging it into the volcanic crater below. Following the Republic's success with saving the colonists, Coburn, Wolffe, and Tano brought the Togrutas aboard the admiral's Star Destroyer, where they received medical treatment.<ref name="Escape from Kadavo" />

[[File:CoburnStrategyConference-PoNR.png|thumb|right|250px|Coburn confers with Mace Windu and Wullf Yularen at the Republic strategy conference.]]
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="FF-2014 58: D-Squad">{{FactFile2014|58|DSQ 1-2|D-Squad}}</ref> Coburn was one of the attendees at the [[Republic strategy conference/Legends|Republic strategy conference]], which was held aboard the [[Valor (space station)/Legends|''Valor'']] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in orbit of [[Carida/Legends|Carida]]. Just before the conference was about to begin, the Separatists attempted to [[Carida Incident|bomb]] the space station with the [[Rhydonium/Legends|rhydonium]]-laden Star Destroyer ''[[Renown/Legends|Renown]]''. However, thanks to the intervention of the Republic's [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]], the crisis was averted.<ref name="Point of No Return">{{TCW|Point of No Return (The Clone Wars)}}</ref><ref name="Facebook: Tarkin">{{Facebook|username=StarWarsTheCloneWars|url=photo.php?fbid=494382640601035|name=''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''|date=2013-01-15|quote=The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] failed to prevent the capture of one of their [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]], the ''[[Renown/Legends|Renown]]'', and upon interception of encrypted transmissions regarding this plot, dispatched their own mission&mdash;separate from, and unsanctioned by, [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]]&mdash;to recover a [[Encryption module/Legends|decryption module]].|archivefile=File:Memo.jpg}}</ref>

Following a [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|terrorist bombing]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], Coburn was among the Republic officers invited to attend the [[Funeral of the Jedi Temple bombing victims/Legends|funeral]] for the six [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] who perished in the attack. He was one of a select number of guests who were not members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], other notable attendees being [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and several [[Senator/Legends|members]] of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. Alongside fellow admirals Wilhuff Tarkin and [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]], Coburn stood through the proceedings while Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] delivered the eulogy memorializing the fallen Jedi, recalling that all of them were luminous beings, their bodies vessels for [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The six cloth-draped bodies were then lowered into a lower coffin chamber, ending the ceremony.<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much">{{TCW|The Jedi Who Knew Too Much}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
[[File:CoburnDetail-SWE.png|thumb|left|150px|A respected fleet officer, Coburn served under Plo Koon.]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] male, Coburn stood 1.81 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] high and had fair skin,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> light [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and graying [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="Citadel Rescue" /> A disciplined commander, Coburn emanated an unmistakable command presence with his stern face and steely gaze, measuring his words exactly and never saying more than needed. His orders were clear<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and to the point, making them easy to follow.<ref name="Escape from Kadavo" /> He maintained a tight ship aboard his flagship. Coburn earned respect as an admiral of the Republic Navy and was assigned to serve under General Plo Koon. He worked closely with Koon and his clone commander, Wolffe; Coburn coordinated battlefield tasks with the latter to ensure maximum effectiveness. He never forgot the fate of Koon's ''Triumphant'' after its destruction by the ''Malevolence''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

Coburn remained steadfast even while taking part in some of the more daring assignments under Jedi leadership,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> including operations at Lola Sayu<ref name="Citadel Rescue" /> and Kadavo. During the latter mission, he did not hesitate to bring his light cruiser, the ''Hand of Justice'', dangerously close to the slave processing facility, as it was necessary to rescue the Togruta slaves from their holding cell.<ref name="Escape from Kadavo" /> He spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] in a clipped accent.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Equipment==
While on duty, he wore the uniform of a Republic fleet [[Officer/Legends|officer]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|With a stern face, steely glare and unmistakable command presence, Admiral Coburn served at the side of General Plo Koon during the Clone Wars.|The introduction to Coburn's entry in the StarWars.com Encyclopedia|<ref name="Encyclopedia" />}}
The character of Admiral Coburn was created for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. He made his first appearance in [[March]] [[2011]] in the episode "[[Citadel Rescue]]," which aired as part of the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]].<ref name="Citadel Rescue Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode320.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Citadel Rescue}}</ref> He was later featured in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]] episode "[[Escape from Kadavo]]," which was released on [[January 5]], [[2012]].<ref name="Explore: Escape from Kadavo">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep411|text="Kidnapped" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide"|nolive=1}}</ref> As part of his appearance in the latter episode, he received an entry in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Encyclopedia (StarWars.com)|Encyclopedia]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Coburn was voiced by voice actor [[Dee Bradley Baker]] in "Citadel Rescue,"<ref name="Citadel Rescue Ep Guide" /> but his voice actor for "Escape from Kadavo" has yet to be attributed.<ref name="Escape from Kadavo" /> The character has since appeared in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]] episodes "[[Point of No Return (The Clone Wars)|Point of No Return]]" and "[[The Jedi Who Knew Too Much]]."<ref name="Point of No Return" /><ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much" />
